topic: How to encourage without nagging: the deal that works
caption:
Nagging rarely works. A deal usually does.
Tell your teen: earn $20 this week and you'll match it. One simple offer changes the whole conversation.
HustleUp shows them exactly which hustle to start and how to land their first customer in days.
